caseNameFull: Don W. Davis v. Ray Hobbs, Interim Director, Arkansas Department of Corrections and Don W. Davis v. Ray Hobbs, Interim Director, Arkansas Department of Corrections

opinions.text:
The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit and the application for stay of execution of sentence of death in the above-entitled case were dismissed today pursuant to this Court’s Rule 46.

Same case below, 594 F.3d 592 (No. 09-10120).
